Last 10 overs 30 runs, 0 wkts 17.1 Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Chanderpaul, no run, tossed up full on middle, a forward defence to cover Over 17 64-1 4 0 6 0 0 0 ( 10 runs) John Campbell 35 (46) Tagenarine Chanderpaul 14 (36) Taijul Islam 1-0-10-0 Over Summary View all overs 16.6 Taijul Islam to John Campbell, no run, flat good length outside off, John Campbell goes on the back foot and punches it back to Taijul Islam. Jaker goes "bhalo bhalo" [nice nice] in Bangla 16.5 Taijul Islam to John Campbell, no run, tossed up full on off, John Campbell with a watchful forward defence 16.4 Taijul Islam to John Campbell, no run, full on off, John Campbell gets forward to drive it back A slip and a forward short-leg. Deep square leg back. 16.3 6 Taijul Islam to John Campbell, SIX , wow that is some shot. It's tossed up and turning into off and middle, John Campbell gets forward and hoicks it. Didn't bother about the deep square leg fielder. Goes all the way. Middled that so well 16.2 Taijul Islam to John Campbell, no run, flat back of a length and turns into off, John Campbell goes on the back foot to defend 16.1 4 Taijul Islam to John Campbell, FOUR , starts with a juicy low full-toss on middle, John Campbell sees it and laps it around the corner. Jaker anticipates and stretches out his right leg, the ball just eludes it and runs away to the fine-leg fence Taijul Islam, Left arm orthodox, comes into the attack Interesting to see the gully squatting and he is there only for Tagenarine Chanderpaul. Not for John Campbell. Over 16 54-1 1 0 0 1 0 0 ( 2 runs) Tagenarine Chanderpaul 14 (36) John Campbell 25 (40) Mehidy Hasan Miraz 5-1-12-0 Over Summary View all overs 15.6 Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Chanderpaul, no run, quicker good length delivery on off, Tagenarine Chanderpaul goes on the back foot and defends it back 15.5 Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Chanderpaul, no run, full on middle, a solid forward defence to the right of Mehidy Hasan Miraz 15.4 Mehidy Hasan Miraz to John Campbell, 1 run, full on leg-stump, John Campbell gets forward and flicks to the left of Mehidy Hasan Miraz. Takes a quick single 15.3 Mehidy Hasan Miraz to John Campbell, no run, that's the ball. Mehidy Hasan Miraz nods at some advice coming his way. 87kph, it lands on a good length on off, then turns past the forward defence. Cracker of a ball and John Campbell so lucky not to edge that 15.2 Mehidy Hasan Miraz to John Campbell, no run, tossed up full on middle, John Campbell gets forward to defend to mid-on 15.1 Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Chanderpaul, 1 run, full on middle, Tagenarine Chanderpaul gets forward to flick to the left of mid-on. Turns the strike over Time for a drink. John Campbell has been lucky so far. He should've been back in the pavilion by now. The seamers haven't been disciplined enough and have leaked boundaries. That's why Shanto has a deep point back. Over 15 52-1 0 0 0 0 0 2 ( 2 runs) John Campbell 24 (37) Chanderpaul 13 (33) Shoriful Islam 5-1-17-0 Over Summary View all overs 14.6 Shoriful Islam to John Campbell, 2 runs, that was a chance. Full outside off, John Campbell gets forward to drive and the face closes. He pops it back and Shoriful Islam is not expecting it. He puts his hands up but it passes them and a better effort could've seen the catch being taken. Campbell continues to live a charmed life. Shoriful may have got a fingertip on that to his left. The bowler looked surprised after the ball went away 14.5 Shoriful Islam to John Campbell, no run, wide of the crease and full outside off, John Campbell again off-drives nicely but straight to the fielder at mid-off 14.4 Shoriful Islam to John Campbell, no run, full on off, John Campbell gets forward and shows the full face of the bat to drive it hard but straight to the fielder at mid-off FEATURED VIDEOS
